scope.reason: Revalidate publisher head-matter ordering and recompute printed paragraph labels from stored raw: local duplicate or OCR markers preserve surrounding labels, and Czech and Slovak separate opinions have independent numbering scopes. AST roles and labels have no separate feature storage. Re-read legacy, suffixed and Unicode Adobe Glyph List names from stored PDF bytes; extraction has no separate feature storage. Rebuild decision text, structure and paragraph identities from archived pages or registry originals; read current scalar metadata separately from related-record evidence and retain conflicting scalar values. Section headings, the formula lines, the takto lead-in and letter-spaced words are recomputed with them. Rebuild inline emphasis from retained PDF originals with the shared style mapper. Discovering an uncaptured original requires a normal re-crawl. Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision, matching judge titles as whole words; they have no feature storage of their own. Read inline style declarations with CSS cascade semantics. Re-read reporter and matched registry fields from captured publisher responses; missing historical captures require a re-crawl. Read letter-spaced emphasis through the one shared reading, once a paragraph's lines are joined: a short spaced word in a text that spaces words, a row of one-letter words no sentence writes, and uneven chunks the document prints nowhere else read as the words they spell; only whitespace in block text changes and it has no feature storage of its own. Signature roles are recomputed from the stored decision through the shared Czech role grammar, which reads the office a judge signs under (the president or a member of an extended or grand chamber, the President of a top court); they have no feature storage of their own. A separate-opinion heading that ends on the docket it names opens that opinion, whose paragraph numbers are its own; a bare name under the closing signs. Roles are recomputed from the stored page: a name printed with its academic degrees under the closing signs the decision beside the office it is signed under. Roles have no feature storage of their own. Printed paragraph labels are read by one grammar: a label opens a paragraph except inside a date wrapped after its day or after a word its number belongs to, sub-paragraphs (`5.5.`) open their own and count as items beside the court's numbering, and positioned-line paragraphs are read by the one line-join owner; block text, boundaries and numbers are recomputed from stored raw and have no feature storage of their own. Re-derive stored citations with rule kinds, polarity evidence windows and cited parts; the canonical AST and publisher metadata do not change.
